instruction: A candid outdoor photograph capturing a full-length shot of a couple on stone steps. On the left, the man in the white puffer jacket (R2) stands facing right, holding the woman in an embrace. On the right, the woman in the pink puffer jacket (R1) stands facing left, holding a bouquet of red roses up to her face, obscuring her features. They stand close together against a grey stone wall. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and emphasizing the bright red roses.
